We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

The case: multiple burglaries (盗窃) - entering houses, breaking doors, stealing cash, cards, IDs, etc. Also false accusation: fabricated false statements that others participated, causing them to be detained. That is likely “诬告陷害罪” (defamation? Actually false accusation leading to criminal detention: “诬告陷害罪” under Chinese criminal law). The description: "捏造王某、王某立参与其多次入室盗窃他人财物，使王某、王某立受到刑事拘留。" That is false accusation causing detention. The crime is "诬告陷害罪". Also the theft is "盗窃罪". Possibly also "抢夺"? No, it's burglary theft. So charges: 盗窃罪; 诬告陷害罪.

Check if any other charges: maybe "非法侵入住宅罪"? In Chinese law, there is "非法侵入住宅罪" (illegal intrusion into a residence). However typical charge for breaking into houses and stealing is "盗窃罪" (burglary). The law also has "入室盗窃罪" (burglary). So "盗窃罪" covers.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃罪;诬告陷害罪<eoa>
